text: At every ordinal stage alpha that is zero or a limit, any two legal stage types on the two coatoms of a finite set of m+2 points, agreeing literally on their common closed face, admit a legal stage type on the whole set with those exact restrictions, including their labels. The extension has a cell of full scope and full grade m+2 carrying the maximum of its labels.
scope: The apex coatom-extension completion criterion, restricted to zero-or-limit stages as in roadmap checkpoint 2.7. No additional universal two-face-lifting hypothesis is part of the criterion. This is a roadmap target, not a quotation from the published paper or the conditional root's docstring.
